comment: #139: instance-backed arrows, spells and bait (eternal spells) given and equipped in place (docs/re/items.md section 22). The game's EquipItem first asks EquipLocationKind (ItemInfo+0x104 through a jump table: types 1-12 and 36 -> 4 Generic, in place; 13-18, 34, 35, 37, 38 -> 2 Equipment; else 0). Kind 4 on a cell of the current entity's own inventory calls SelectEquipment(remove 0, cell, ItemInfo, the stack's own pide); UnequipItem's kind 4 calls it with remove 1 and that pide; the commit's op7 then ORs ItemState+0x0e bit 0x08 (IsEquipped), or clears it for remove. No HasPIDE test on any of these paths. Same bytes on server 26430253 (f0d824be) and client 26430625 (5d9ef2f1); kiln.items calls EquipLocationKind (entry bytes qualified) and otherwise only matches these sites.
